name: 193. Anthropic tool_result is_error keeps status incomplete on the OpenAI Responses wire (#8195 / PR #8209) (tool-result-is-error-status)
description: Gateway regression for #8195. On /anthropic/v1/messages against an OpenAI-backed model the route always builds a Bifrost Responses request, so the Anthropic converter's is_error -> status "incomplete" marker on the function_call_output item is the only thing that tells the model a tool call failed: the chat path strips is_error on the OpenAI wire by design, and an error field on an input item is rejected outright. ToOpenAIResponsesRequest then began clearing status on every input item ("OpenAI rejects status on input"), which left a failed tool result byte-identical to a successful one. Both rows read the outbound body with x-bf-send-back-raw-request, because the loss is invisible in the response: the model simply answers as if the command had worked. Cases: (1) the reporter's shape plus a successful sibling result in the same turn - the failed call_id must carry status "incomplete" (absent pre-fix) while the successful one carries no status at all, and neither may gain an error field; (2) a native /v1/responses request whose function_call_output arrives with status "completed", which must still be stripped before the wire - the exception is only for "incomplete", and widening it would put back the field OpenAI rejects. Run with FEATURE=tool-result-is-error-status.
